# Wood's Plumbing Enterprises LLC

> Licensed plumbing contractor serving Southern Arizona since 1979. Family-owned business providing residential and commercial plumbing services including emergency repairs, water heaters, gas services, sewer lines, and leak detection across Marana, Tucson, Oro Valley, and surrounding areas. Available 24/7 for emergency plumbing services with no overtime charges. Licensed ROC #296386 (CR-37 Plumbing).

Wood's Plumbing Enterprises LLC is a trusted plumbing company with over 45 years of experience serving the Southern Arizona community. We specialize in all aspects of residential and commercial plumbing, from routine maintenance to complex installations and emergency repairs. Founded by Bill Woods in 1979. In 2022 Wood's joined Intelligent Design Home Services (https://www.idesignac.com), the family- and veteran-owned Tucson home services company founded by U.S. Marine Corps veteran Andrew Dobbins. Wood's keeps its own name, Marana shop, phone number and Google Business Profile. For heating, cooling, electrical and solar, Wood's customers are referred to Intelligent Design.

- **Hours**: 24/7 Emergency Service Available
- **Response Time**: 15-20 minutes for emergencies in Marana and surrounding communities; 60-90 minutes for greater Tucson area.

## Services

- [Emergency Plumbing](/services/emergency-plumbing): 24/7 emergency plumber services for burst pipes, major leaks, and plumbing emergencies
- [Water Heater Services](/services/water-heater-installation): Installation, repair, and replacement of tank and tankless water heaters (specializing in hard water solutions)
- [Gas Line Services](/services/gas-line-installation): Licensed gas plumber for gas line installation, repair, and leak detection
- [Sewer Services](/services/sewer-line-repair): Sewer line repair, replacement, trenchless sewer repair, and video camera inspection
- [Leak Detection](/services/leak-detection): Advanced electronic leak detection for hidden water leaks and slab leak repair
- [Drain Cleaning](/services/drain-cleaning): Professional drain cleaning and hydro jetting services
- [Water Conditioning](/services/water-softener-installation): Water softener and reverse osmosis system installation
- [Repiping](/services/whole-house-repiping): Complete home repiping with copper or PEX
